products.name: Peach Milk Soft Crème Moisturiser
products.description: Lakmé's everyday face crème blends peach extract with milk proteins in a light, non-greasy texture that sinks in quickly. It keeps skin soft and supple for up to 24 hours and sits well under makeup.
bullets: Works as a smooth base for makeup
products.howToUse: Take a small amount and dot on the forehead, cheeks and chin. Spread in gentle upward strokes until absorbed. Use morning and night.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: Demineralised Water, Cyclopentasiloxane, Sorbitol, Sunflower Seed Oil, Isohexadecane, Glycol Stearate, Titanium Dioxide, Dimethiconol, Polysorbate 80, Peach Extract (Prunus Persica), Non-fat Dry Milk, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone, Citronellol, CI 14700.

images.alt: Lakmé Peach Milk Soft Crème jar, lid view

products.name: Absolute Argan Oil Serum Foundation SPF 45
products.description: A lightweight serum foundation from the Lakmé Absolute range, infused with argan oil for a fresh, skin-like glow. Buildable coverage evens out the look of skin tone, with SPF 45 for daytime wear.
products.howToUse: Shake well. Dot a few drops over the face and blend outward with fingertips, a brush or a damp sponge. Build a second layer where needed.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil, broad-spectrum UV filters (SPF 45), Iron Oxides for colour.

images.alt: Lakmé Absolute Argan Oil Serum Foundation SPF 45 carton

products.name: Peach Milk Ultra Light Gel Moisturiser
products.description: An oil-free gel version of the Peach Milk moisturiser, made for humid days and oily or combination skin. The water-light texture absorbs fast and keeps skin hydrated for up to 24 hours without shine.
bullets: Peach extract for a fresh finish
products.howToUse: Apply a small amount to clean face and neck and massage in until absorbed. Use morning and night, or as often as skin feels tight.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: Peach Extract (Prunus Persica), Milk Protein, Glycerin.

images.alt: Lakmé Peach Milk Ultra Light-Weight Gel jar, lid view

products.name: Peach Milk Vit E + SPF 24 Moisture-Riser Lotion
products.description: A two-in-one day lotion that pairs Vitamin E with SPF 24 sun protection, so moisturising and sun care happen in one step. It leaves skin soft and smooth with a light, non-sticky feel.
bullets: Vitamin E serum for soft, smooth skin
products.howToUse: Apply on cleansed face and neck every morning, smoothing it in evenly. Reapply after long hours outdoors.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: Water, Octyl Salicylate, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane, Glycerine, Palmitic Acid, Stearic Acid, Phenylbenzimidazole Sulphonic Acid; with Vitamin E and peach extract.

images.alt: Lakmé Peach Milk Vit E + SPF 24 Moisture-Riser bottle, front of pack

products.name: Peach Milk Vit E Crème Moisture-Riser
products.description: A rich crème with Vitamin E and peach milk in a value-size jar that works for face and body. It locks in moisture for up to 24 hours while staying non-sticky.
bullets: Vitamin E for soft, nourished skin
Big 300 g jar for face and body
products.howToUse: Scoop a little crème with clean fingers and massage over face, neck, hands or body until absorbed. Use daily, especially after a bath.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E), Peach Extract, Milk Protein, Glycerin.

images.alt: Lakmé Peach Milk Vit E Crème Moisture-Riser jar, lid view

products.name: 9to5 CC Cream SPF 30, Almond
products.description: Lakmé's complexion care cream gives sheer, natural coverage that evens out the look of skin tone while it moisturises. SPF 30 PA++ makes it an easy one-step base for office days.
bullets: Sheer coverage that blends into skin
Shade: Almond, for medium skin tones
products.howToUse: Dot on the forehead, cheeks, nose and chin and blend outward with fingertips. Layer lightly for more coverage.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: UV filters (SPF 30 PA++), Glycerin, Titanium Dioxide and Iron Oxides for tinted coverage.

images.alt: Lakmé 9to5 CC Cream tube with carton, shade Almond

products.name: 9to5 Sun Expert Tint Hint Sunscreen SPF 50 PA+++
products.description: A lightly tinted sunscreen from the Sun Expert range that blurs and evens the look of skin while offering broad-spectrum SPF 50 PA+++. The hint of tint helps avoid a white cast on Indian skin tones.
products.howToUse: Apply generously to face and neck 15 minutes before stepping out. Reapply every 2-3 hours when outdoors or after sweating.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: Broad-spectrum UV filters (SPF 50 PA+++), Glycerine, Iron Oxides for the sheer tint.

images.alt: Lakmé 9to5 Sun Expert Tint Hint SPF 50 tube, front of pack

products.name: 9to5 Powerplay Priming Powder Foundation
products.description: A three-in-one pressed powder that primes, covers and sets in one swipe, from the Lakmé 9to5 Fashionista collection. It gives a soft-matte finish that keeps shine in check through the workday.
bullets: Primer, foundation and powder in one
Slim compact with mirror for touch-ups
products.howToUse: Swipe the sponge over the powder and press onto the face, starting at the centre and blending outward. Touch up through the day as needed.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: Talc, Mica, Silica, Titanium Dioxide and Iron Oxides (pressed powder pigments).

images.alt: Lakmé 9to5 Powerplay Priming Powder Foundation carton

Palmitoyl peptides in a light crème
Peach juice and sweet almond oil

products.name: Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Serum
products.description: Pairs 2% salicylic acid with 5% niacinamide to unclog pores and calm the look of breakouts and marks on oily, acne-prone skin. Willow bark, centella and alpha arbutin round out the lightweight, fragrance-free formula.

Fades the look of post-acne marks over time

products.description: A 2% salicylic acid serum with witch hazel and willow bark that exfoliates inside the pore to help keep blackheads and breakouts in check. The trial-size 10 ml bottle is an easy way to start a BHA routine.

products.description: A gentle daily cleanser with 1% kojic acid, 1% niacinamide and alpha arbutin for skin that looks uneven or dull. It washes off clean without leaving skin tight.

Helps reduce visible flakes and itchiness

products.description: A leave-in hair serum with a 5% maleic acid bond-repair complex, amino acids, argan oil and squalane for hair stressed by colour, heat or straightening. It smooths frizz and leaves lengths softer and shinier.

products.howToUse: Work 2-3 pumps through damp or dry lengths and ends, avoiding the scalp. Style as usual; no need to rinse.
products.ingredients: Key ingredients: Maleic Bond Repair Complex (5%), Amino Acids, Argania Spinosa (Argan) Kernel Oil, Squalane.

products.description: A no-gas perfume body spray with a warm, smoky whisky-and-wood character built for evenings out. The concentrated formula gives more sprays per can and a longer-lasting trail than regular deodorants.
